title: Producers and consumer groups
dek: A producer's guarantees stop at sessions and retries, and a consumer's position says what was handed over, not what was finished. This fourth part of a five-part teardown reads the clients of Apache Kafka 4.4.0: two threads around a queue, what linger really decides, a key hash that differs by client, the broker state idempotence leans on and the places it runs out, a commit decoded byte by byte, the classic barrier against KIP-848's heartbeat, and share groups that replace ownership with leases.
byline: 6 November 2026 · Subject: kafka@1156b275 (Apache Kafka 4.4.0) · Part 4 of 5 · Read from the source; measured where this machine allows
description: Apache Kafka 4.4.0 taken apart, part 4: the producer's accumulator and Sender, linger and batch size, partitioners across clients, idempotence and where it runs out, consumer position and commits, classic and KIP-848 rebalances, static membership and share groups.
og_description: Part 4 of a five-part Kafka teardown at 1156b275 (4.4.0): two threads around a queue, linger against batch.size, broker dedupe state and where it runs out, the first-batch overtake (KAFKA-19880), a commit decoded by hand, the classic barrier against KIP-848, and share-group leases. Timings are loopback on a shared 2-vCPU box: relative only.

badges_callout:
How to read the badges

from the code marks a fact read from the pinned sources, cited as repo/path:line: Apache Kafka 4.4.0 (1156b275), librdkafka v2.16.0 (c6c9973c) and franz-go (123ec885). Short prefixes stand for long paths under kafka/: producer/ and consumer/ are the two packages in clients/src/main/java/org/apache/kafka/clients/; log/ is storage/src/main/java/org/apache/kafka/storage/internals/log/; group/ is group-coordinator/src/main/java/org/apache/kafka/coordinator/group/. common/ sits beside clients/ in the same tree, and a … elides a module's source root. A bare file name was cited in full earlier. measured here marks output from the research box: real Java 4.4.0 clients and a franz-go build against live brokers, all on loopback on a shared 2-vCPU machine. Timings show relative behaviour, never capacity. Faults injected through a proxy are named as such. Each scenario is a single run unless a count is given. librdkafka was read, never run, so its figures are computed. Trunk was read, never built. reconstruction marks a judgement or a drawing made from those sources rather than read in one place.

This is Part 4 of 5 of Kafka, taken apart. Part 1 reads the log on disk; Part 2 follows one request through the broker; Part 3 covers what an ack promises, replication and the metadata quorum; Part 5 covers exactly-once, and ends with the findings register.
